messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your doctor if your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine"
set: ["tell your doctor if your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "talk with your doctor if you think your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "should not breastfeed while using this medicine", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "call your doctor if condition does not improve or gets worse while using this medicine", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "call your doctor if the child is restless", "call your doctor if the child is hostile", "call your doctor if the child is aggressive", "tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve", "tests can help your doctor determine if this medicine is effective", "tell your doctor if you have a history of seizures before starting this medicine", "tell your doctor if these do not settle", "stop treatment if child is not growing or gaining weight as expected", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
